title: Canonical open base-change components respect nested restriction
statement: Fix derived categories of modules for all schemes [def-pc-derived-category], a commutative square g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S, g:S′→S with g′;f=f′;g [def-pc-scheme], K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), and ψ:Lg′*K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let W⊆U be opens, i:W→U their inclusion, and i′:g′⁻¹W→g′⁻¹U its inverse image. Use the fixed canonical exact-open adjunctions and define ρ_U,W by schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Put F=Rf_*;Lg*, G=Rf′_* and let a_U,a_W be the pasted components [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components, def-pc-derived-base-change-map, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then F(ρ_U,W(K));a_W=a_U;G(ρ_U′,W′(K′)). No covering, affine, compactness, quasi-coherence or cartesian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 08HY and 08BV; perfect.tex Tag 0DJ9 induction step; Tag 0D5S for the specified composition comparisons

proof.text: Expand nested-open restriction as the smaller-open adjunction transpose of the larger-open counit transported through the exact restriction composition isomorphism. Naturality of that comparison and the left triangle identity show η_U;ρ_U,W=η_W. This is private open_restriction_unit.

Restriction to U makes η_U invertible. Apply further overlap restriction, transport by schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso, apply pullback on W, and transport by mvPullbackOpenRestrictionIso. Thus restriction to W′ inverts Lq*(η_U).

For any adjunction L⊣R, if L(u) is invertible, precomposition with u is injective on maps into R(T): transpose and cancel L(u). Apply this to the smaller inverse-image open. After precomposition with Lq*(η_U), one local-square path reduces to Lq*(η_W);β_W=ψ;η_W′, and the other to ψ;η_U′;ρ_U′,W′=ψ;η_W′. The local square follows by injectivity.
Coefficient naturality of BC_f at ρ_U,W reduces the full square to Rf′_* of the local square. Apply functoriality and reassociate. Equal or empty opens are included throughout.

proof_origin.place: Unit uniqueness proof of the restriction square in Tags 08BV and 0DJ9; avoids triple-comparison coherence

lean.statement:
theorem mvBaseChangeOpenMap_restriction
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (ψ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    {W U : X.Opens} (i : W ⟶ U) :
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ derivedPullback g).map
        (schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X i
          (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X U) (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X W) K) ≫
      mvBaseChangeOpenMap f f' g g' h K K' ψ W =
    mvBaseChangeOpenMap f f' g g' h K K' ψ U ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map
        (schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X' ((Opens.map g'.base).map i)
          (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ U))
          (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) K')
